context: Yumiko teaches Hina how to crack an egg.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ひなちゃん、卵割る技術、教えるね。
lines.en: Hina-chan, I'll teach you how to crack an egg properly.
lines.style: Warm, patient opening. Soft voice drawing her in. A small smile audible in the tone. Settling into teaching mode—present, unhurried, genuinely happy to pass this on.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright, eager commitment. Her voice sits higher, focused and sincere. No performance—just the pure concentration of an eight-year-old trying to do something right for someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Gentle guidance, each word landing with quiet intention. No rush. The tone says: you can do this, and I'm right here. Almost a rhythm to it.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Pure delight and small pride. Her voice jumps up, genuine surprise at her own success. Not performed—the real, unguarded joy of a child who just did something for the first time.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Reflective warmth. She's speaking to the moment itself, not just to Hina. Tender underneath, with a note of quiet gratitude for this. Slightly slower pace, savoring it.
